faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Belvedere?
faq.answer: Belvedere homeowners typically invest $20,000 to $60,000+ for window replacement projects. The city's waterfront and hillside estate homes frequently feature large custom windows and sliding glass door systems that frame views of San Francisco Bay. Custom-sized Marvin Ultimate or Western Window Systems projects for larger estates can exceed $80,000.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Belvedere?
faq.answer: Yes. All window replacements in Belvedere require a building permit. Additionally, many properties require approval from the Belvedere Design Review Board, which evaluates exterior changes to ensure they are consistent with the city's strict design standards and view corridor protections. We coordinate all permitting and design review submittals on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Belvedere?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Belvedere commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Belvedere?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Belvedere replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Belvedere?
faq.answer: Most Belvedere projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
